1.label: Mild NPDR
1.description: Mild non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy — microaneurysms only

2.label: Moderate NPDR
2.description: Moderate non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy — more than just microaneurysms but less than severe NPDR

3.label: Severe NPDR
3.description: Severe non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy — extensive intraretinal hemorrhages, venous beading, IRMA

4.label: Proliferative DR
4.description: Proliferative diabetic retinopathy — neovascularization, vitreous/preretinal hemorrhage

note: ICD-10 codes are illustrative for the research prototype. Actual coding requires clinical determination.
